content.text: The mirror can answer the question; the JQL subset refuses it.
gadak: cannot apply JQL — parent = TAP-1 (not in the subset)
sqlite> SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues_full WHERE parent_key = 'NMB-199';
canonicalField in internal/jql/compile.go:202-242 has no parent entry, so the clause falls through to skip. Nothing needs to be fetched from the origin — parent_key is already there.
An agent that copies a filter out of Jira gets an empty or partial list from a clause the mirror could have answered. Unlike sprint, this one costs a mapping and nothing else.
Fix shape: map parent = and parent IN onto parent_key in internal/jql (types.go, compile.go, match.go). Do not fold sprint into this patch — sprint has no column.
Gate: parent = NMB-199 returns the same key set as the SQL above; today that test fails with 'cannot apply'.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track C, score 8/10).
